children: CaixaBank SA (BME:CABK) posted nine-month net profit of €4.96 billion, up 12.9% year over year, as income rose 4.4% to €12.66 billion. It also agreed to sell BPI’s remaining 33.5% stake in Banco de Fomento Angola for more than €388.5 million, pending regulatory approval and Unitel’s decision not to match.
Previous Week Recap
Nine-Month Profit Rises 12.9%
: CaixaBank (CABK) posted €4.96 billion in nine-month net profit, up 12.9% year over year. Income rose 4.4% to €12.66 billion, while expenses increased 4.3% to €5 billion.
€1 Billion Green Bond
: CaixaBank (CABK) issued a €1 billion, five-year green bond with a 3.875% coupon. Orders reached a record €4.5 billion, allowing the spread to tighten from 100 to 70 basis points over mid-swaps.
Angola Stake Sale Agreed
: CaixaBank (CABK), via BPI, agreed to sell its remaining 33.5% stake in Angola’s Banco de Fomento Angola for over €388.5 million, pending regulatory approval and Unitel’s decision not to match.
UBS Forecasts €15.8B Returns
: UBS estimates CaixaBank will return €15.8 billion to shareholders through dividends and buybacks from 2026 to 2028, including €4.51 billion in 2026, €5.49 billion in 2027 and €5.79 billion in 2028.
Deposit Costs Threaten Earnings
: Analysts warn higher deposit costs may pressure CaixaBank’s earnings: each 10-basis-point rise could cut net interest income 4%. Loans grew 7.5% and deposits 3%.
BPI Ends Equity-Method Recognition
: CaixaBank’s BPI reclassified its 35.7% stake in Mozambique’s Banco Comercial e de Investimentos after reassessing its influence, ending equity-method income recognition.
Jefferies Sees AI Race Winner
: Jefferies named CaixaBank SA (CABK) a potential AI race winner, citing its investment capacity and scope to boost operating efficiency.
Palo Alto Partnership Extended
: CaixaBank (CABK) extended its Palo Alto Networks partnership through 2030, focusing on AI-related cyber threats and strengthening security through innovation and ongoing protection improvements.
Study: 1.5% Spain GDP Contribution
: A 2026 study estimates CaixaBank (CABK) contributes 1.5% of Spain’s GDP, citing its 22 million-plus customers and financing for households and businesses.
Apple Pay Instalments Introduced
: CaixaBank (CABK) now lets eligible customers split Apple Pay in-store purchases into instalments using compatible credit cards, with repayment plans managed through its app.
